meta.title: ZX2200 First Direct Pickup — Runtime Sequence

messages.label: carrier arrival
messages.note: E09: TransferToBondFinishedSignal.Set / Wait; transport completes before this signal.

messages.label: InjectSteps(carrier)
messages.note: E10: BondTask.cs:192–194; compensation checks precede injection.

messages.label: GetNextActionNode()
messages.note: E10–E11: first unfinished action; earlier preparation nodes omitted.

messages.label: PickActionNode
messages.note: E11: component step; this sequence selects the first direct wafer-camera pickup.

messages.label: DoWork()
messages.note: E10: BondTask.cs:226–232; IsDoWork must allow execution.

messages.label: request first chip
messages.note: E12: SetCurrentNeedChipName then IsBondNeedChipSignal.Set; asynchronous request.

messages.label: die ready
messages.note: E13: change carrier if needed, Block.NextDie, IsWaferAllowPickSignal.Set; Pick waits via System2RunTimeProvider.

messages.label: pickup result
messages.note: E12: physical pickup occurs after readiness; no flip table in this selected path.

messages.label: mark finished
messages.note: E15: FinishCurrentActionNode for handled completion; Retry leaves unfinished, Abort stops.

messages.label: next action
messages.note: E11: next unfinished recipe message, repeated until none.

messages.label: correct / bond
messages.note: E11: separate DoWork calls summarized: UpLook correction → substrate-camera correction → Bond. Inspection only when selected.

messages.label: action results
messages.note: E15: apply result policy after each individual call; this arrow summarizes that repeated interaction.

messages.label: Finish()
messages.note: E10: no remaining nodes, move safe, reset action-message state.

messages.label: release carrier
messages.note: E10: AllowBondTransferToWaitingUnloadSignal.Set; actual transfer also requires empty destination. Next carrier loop follows.

cards.title: Selected execution path
items: Normal transport + first direct wafer-camera pickup; no flip.
Concurrent tasks are synchronized by events, not timed RPCs.

cards.title: Read with the source summary
items: E09–E15 map every interaction to local files and line ranges.
Repeated action calls are condensed; retries remain in the workflow.
